method: 400k-message synthetic fixture; first uncached panel call after all rollups finish, helpers already warm; then median of five exact-query cache hits. Snapshot times are accumulated Core checks; profile statements run in the read worker. External machine load was not controlled.

WITH source AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT m.kind, m.date, m.term, m.n, m.first_ts, m.last_ts, m.seq, m.position, m.payload FROM p_stats_rollup_text_v1_visible m WHERE m.kind IN ('extent', 'lengths', 'emoji') AND 1 AND m.channel_id IN (SELECT ? UNION ALL SELECT id FROM archive_all_channels WHERE is_thread = 1 AND parent_id = ?) AND 1 AND 1 AND m.day NOT IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)))
    SELECT 'extent' AS kind, '' AS date, '' AS term, 0 AS n, MIN(first_ts) AS first_ts, MAX(last_ts) AS last_ts,
      0 AS seq, 0 AS position, '{}' AS payload FROM source WHERE kind = 'extent' HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
    UNION ALL SELECT 'lengths', s.date, '', SUM(json_extract(j.value, '$[1]')), MIN(s.first_ts), MAX(s.last_ts), 0, 0,
      json_array(json_array(0, SUM(json_extract(j.value, '$[1]')), SUM(json_extract(j.value, '$[2]')), SUM(json_extract(j.value, '$[3]'))))
      FROM source s CROSS JOIN json_each(s.payload) j WHERE s.kind = 'lengths' GROUP BY s.date
    UNION ALL SELECT kind, date, term, n, first_ts, last_ts, seq, position, payload FROM source WHERE kind = 'emoji'
